test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How long (in years) will a sum of money invested at 6% per annum simple interest to increase its value by 40%?
solution:
Given:

Rate of interest = 6%

The principal will be increased its value by 40%

Formula used:

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]

Calculation:

Let,T = time and principal (P) = 100 

The simple interest got by the person is 40

As per the formula,

40 = 100 × 6 × T / 100

⇒ T = 40 /6

⇒ 20/3years = 6(2)/(3) years

∴ The correct option is 1
